title: Occupational hazards (violence in the workplace)
coreMove: Make workplace process capture repeated grievance and access pressure before one decisive incident appears.
sourcePressure: Workplaces can normalize grievance, access conflict, and escalation through routine process; institutions need processes that preserve behavioral signal instead of burying it.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating workplace violence as a sudden HR surprise or reducing it to disgruntlement.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact for this chapter; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.
